title.narrative: Commonwealth Call to Action on Living Lands

description.narrative: The project will support the programme by providing evidence-based analysis to influence policy, provide expertise for financing, technical assistance, and capacity building to enhance climate change adaptation and mitigation in member countries. By leveraging the array of knowledge and expertise within the Commonwealth through the Commonwealth Call to Action on Living Lands (CALL) thematic working groups, the Secretariat will support member countries in achieving their Rio conventions targets and wider sustainable development ambitions.?
